Unified routing-list parser and per-tunnel routing controls.

- Add separate Tunnel1 and Tunnel2 routing lists, with fail-closed routing and an atomic `awg2_rule` generator for second-tunnel presets.
- Add compact import and export icons to all six list blocks. Import native entries, hosts and AdBlock files, and plain or YAML Mihomo rule providers without applying changes before Save.
- Normalize imported entries, remove duplicates, report redundant and shadowed rules, and show precise localized errors without partially applying an invalid list.
- Compare domain masks exactly, including `+.`, `.`, and `*` labels, and harden parsing with DNS limits and fuzz-tested canonical round trips.
- Link routing controls to the relevant help and list sections, remove the redundant AWG2 caption, and add `telegram.dog` to the Telegram preset.
